items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: this is 18 to 20 numbers patterned after the Lucky Strike, B. A. Rolfe thing

ctx.x: come in? What do I do to play? And you write a few things out for him, he'll play anything, as far as that's concerned, but to do that studio stuff, it was not for Bix. I would say. They always say that he wasn't really happy in that situation.

Well, at this time, you know, there's another thing. We're not making many records, we're doing a radio show and this is 18 to 20 numbers patterned after the Lucky Strike, B. A. Rolfe thing, this is 16, 18, 20 numbers an hour and you had to have the cuts, you had everything marked and at your rehearsal, which Roy was now in front of the band --
